sources.role: Explicit per-date closure list reporting BEI announcement Peng-00171/BEI.POP/09-2025 and 239 trading days.
Independent monthly trading-day counts and the December 24/25/31 closures; corroborates the set as a whole.

corroboration_method: One explicit per-date list plus independent monthly trading-day counts; removing the 22 listed closures from the 261 weekdays of 2026 yields exactly the 239 trading days both sources report. Individual dates are not independently double-sourced beyond that aggregate check.
